name: Mimic

traits.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only).
traits.text: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A creature within 5 ft. must succeed on a DC 13 DEX save or be grappled. The mimic can have up to 4 creatures grappled at a time.

traits.name: False Appearance.
traits.text: The mimic can use its action to alter its form to look like an object (chest, door, furniture, etc.). A successful DC 20 Investigation check reveals its true form.

traits.name: Shapechanger.
traits.text: The mimic can use its action to polymorph into an object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form.

actions.name: Pseudopod.
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the mimic is in object form, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage and DC 13 STR save or grappled.

actions.name: Bite.
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) acid damage.
